intent: Start in broad meadow, climb clover slopes, cross a stream and squeeze through the hedge before the fields open again.

sections.name: The low meadow
sections.lesson: Stay low over the first roots

signs.text:
The low meadow
Stay low over the first roots

sections.name: The clover slopes
sections.lesson: Follow the clover up the bank

signs.text:
The clover slopes
Follow the clover up the bank

The shallow stream
Use the broad bridge stones

sections.name: Within the hedgerow
sections.lesson: The route narrows between the hedges

signs.text:
Within the hedgerow
The route narrows between the hedges

The open field beyond
The horizon opens again
